info.title: dakim pay merchant aggregation API
info.description: Merchant integration contract for the local virtual gateway and configured partner test connectors. Authenticate server-to-server. Amounts use integer minor units of the merchant program currency. Preserve order, allocation, quote, original operation and idempotency keys across retries. Only the gateway chooses the processor route. A capture, browser return or webhook alone does not authorize merchandise release. See [settlement and journal](gateway-finance.md) and [signed event delivery](gateway-webhooks.md).

post.summary: Stage one signed correction to a booked fee
post.description: Submits a distinct single-line correction payout. Stage does not post money or issue a confirmed export. Requires exact original payment, fee allocation and eligible close. A replay of identical terms returns the existing corrected payout.

get.summary: Read a bank-confirmed approved fee correction
get.description: Use the corrected payout ID in its pinned acquiring route and upstream account. Available to a merchant, finance user or reviewer in that merchant book. Rechecks bank evidence and close eligibility at read time.

200.description: A current eligible fee posting. Repeated reads return the same posting identity.

409.description: Bank matching, approval or current evidence is insufficient or contradictory.

merchantBearer.description: One case-sensitive Bearer credential for the merchant program, obtained out of band. The gateway requires 32–256 token bytes. Financial reads also accept finance or reviewer credentials within the same merchant program.

statementBearer.description: Statement credential for the exact merchant, processor route and upstream account. Its configured fee_correction_keys map binds key IDs to raw Ed25519 public keys encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one persistent merchant request key. Reuse it with the original economic terms after a timeout or lost response.

OriginalID.name: id
OriginalID.description: Original gateway identifier returned by the create operation.

payment_method.description: Omit for the default card route in aggregate mode. Discover availability before presenting the option.

terminal_id.description: Required and nonempty on terminal, omit on hosted.

order_total_minor.description: Defaults to amount_minor when omitted or zero. Must cover this allocation and stay constant across split tenders.

replaces_id.description: Previous operation on the same allocation. Replacement requires a definitive unpaid decline.

checkout_url.description: Scoped buyer URL for pending hosted checkout. Retain it as a secret and accept only the enrolled checkout origin.

FeeCorrectionTerms.description: Original booked fee and signed change in minor units. The sum of original_fee_minor and delta_minor must fit the supported range and be at most zero. The corrected payout, bank trace and processor source digest must differ from the original settlement.

SignedFeeCorrection.description: Sign with Ed25519 over the UTF-8 prefix dakimpay/settlement-fee-correction/1 followed by a single LF byte (0x0a), then compact UTF-8 JSON containing key_id and terms in that order. Within terms, serialize the fields in the order specified by the required array in FeeCorrectionTerms. Use ordinary base-10 integer tokens, no whitespace, no trailing newline, unescaped ASCII identifiers. Submit the 64-byte signature as 128 lowercase hex characters. The gateway reconstructs the signed bytes from strict typed input. Duplicated, unknown and null fields are rejected.

BookedFeeCorrection.description: Archived submitted envelope and public key selected by the gateway at admission.

ConfirmedFeeCorrection.description: One eligible merchant fee posting; deduplicate by posting_id. The order and tender allocation identify the existing purchase. An export represents a signed fee change and does not create another retail receipt.
